verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation documents a one-switch dark mode toggle (fedora-docs-7), so users can instantly flip the desktop between light and dark appearances. That is effectively two built-in styles, not a choice among multiple full themes, and no evidence shows a theme picker or wider built-in theme set. Missing for 10: more than a light/dark pair of built-in themes, evidence that the switch restyles the whole desktop and all apps, and independent hands-on corroboration of theme switching.
